say.OpenAPI-to-MCP: Open A P I to M C P

scenes.name: PLAINTEXT
lines: Giving an autonomous agent your raw API keys is like taping your house keys to a stranger's forehead.
把明文 API 密钥塞进 Agent 环境变量，就像把家门钥匙贴在陌生人额头上。
One poisoned webpage or prompt injection, and every connected service falls in a single turn.
只需一页带毒网页或一次提示注入，所有相连服务就会在一轮之内全线沦陷。

scenes.name: VAULT
lines: NyxID breaks that assumption. Secrets stay inside an encrypted proxy; the agent receives only a narrow capability handle.
NyxID 打破了这个错误前提。密钥留在加密代理金库内，Agent 拿到的只是窄作用域能力句柄。
Fifty-five built-in services, forty-one OpenAPI-to-MCP specs, nine messaging channels—zero plaintext secrets in the model window.
五十五项内置服务、四十一份 OpenAPI 转 MCP 规范、九类消息渠道——上下文里的明文密钥始终为零。

scenes.name: REVOKE
lines: Write operations pause at a human approval gate, and revoking a grant converges in roughly two seconds without restarting the sandbox.
写操作在人工闸门前暂停，吊销授权约两秒热生效，无需重启沙箱。
Trust boundaries are engineering, not polite instructions.
信任边界靠工程硬约束，不靠客气的提示词。
